claims.assertion: Swaruu says ships can enter stellar portals through sunspots and tune their frequency to alter a wormhole’s exit; black holes allow entry only.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Taygeta stopped using black-hole transit because communications cannot escape.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says interstellar groups standardize frequency using a hydrogen-molecule vibration cycle measured near absolute zero.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says time is variable rather than a constant.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says polar reversals require a major cause; she attributes Earth’s last reversal to Tiamat’s water impact.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She contrasts this with Earth’s official timeline.
